note: Sodium vapour lamps are near-monochromatic amber, so overall saturation drops to 0.65 and the amber is then painted back into the MIDTONES only (rm up, bm down). Shadows keep a touch of blue (bs) so the unlit parts of frame do not also turn orange - that separation is what reads as streetlight rather than as a plain warm grade. Darkness comes from the grade, never from a night tag.
